name: payables
notes: Beyond the spec's route list the module adds GET /payables/payments, /payables/payments/:id, PUT /payables/payments/:id/certificate (BR-8), PUT /payables/bills/:id, GET /payables/vendors/:id/open-bills and GET /payables/aging. A bill is entered, matched, submitted (tax and withholding are worked out then), approved by the owner, posted and paid. The permission the spec writes as `payables.bill.override-match` is `payables.bill.override_match` because permission codes allow only [a-z0-9_] (see the deviation in the pull request and the proposal in CHANGES.md). The quantity already billed of a receipt line counts every live bill, drafts included. The commitments warning appears once a bill is matched, because the receipts it covers are known only then. Opening vendor balances (BR-12) are created with bills.createOpening; the importer (P2-10) calls it.
